findings.value: A Grade I listed Church of England parish church designed by Sir John Soane, at the centre of its parish since 1828. Besides worship it can be hired for events, and it is raising money for a major restoration project.

evidence.quote: St John on Bethnal Green is a Grade 1 listed building of international significance which has been at the centre of the vibrant parish of Bethnal Green since 1828.
It is one of only three churches to be designed by the world-renowned architect, Sir John Soane.
The church is available to hire for events.
is launching a national call to action to support and raise funds for Phase One of a major renovation project

findings.value: The church says it welcomes anyone, whatever their stage of faith.

evidence.quote: Whoever you are, and wherever you are on your journey of faith, we would love to welcome you.
